description: Flat metadata schema for tissue specimens stained with chemical stains (e.g., H&E) to support morphological and pathology assessment, including stain formulation, source, batch details, protocol, and modifications.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or stained specimen/slide entry.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier of the originating tissue specimen or sample.

slide_id.descr: Identifier for the histology slide, if applicable.

image_id.descr: Identifier for the digital image or scan derived from the stained slide, if applicable.

tissue_type.descr: Tissue category analyzed, e.g., liver, lung, kidney, skin.

anatomical_site.descr: Anatomical source/site of the tissue, if known, e.g., left lobe, colon biopsy.

organism_species.descr: Species of origin for the tissue, e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus.

strain_or_line.descr: Organism strain, genetic line, or cell line origin if relevant.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor/source, if known.

age.descr: Age of the donor/source at collection, in years or as otherwise specified in accompanying documentation.

age_unit.descr: Unit for age, e.g., years, months, days.

disease_state.descr: Disease, condition, or health status associated with the tissue source.

diagnosis.descr: Pathology diagnosis or clinical interpretation associated with the specimen.

collection_date.descr: Date the tissue specimen was collected.

fixation_method.descr: Primary fixation method used before staining, e.g., formalin fixation.

fixative.descr: Chemical fixative used, e.g., 10% neutral buffered formalin.

processing_method.descr: Tissue processing workflow prior to sectioning, e.g., dehydration, clearing, paraffin embedding.

embedding_medium.descr: Embedding medium used, e.g., paraffin, OCT.

section_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of tissue section in micrometers (µm).

section_orientation.descr: Orientation of sectioning relative to the tissue, e.g., transverse, sagittal, coronal.

stain_name.descr: Name of the stain or stain combination, e.g., hematoxylin and eosin (H&E).

stain_class.descr: General stain class, e.g., routine histological, special stain, immunostain.

stain_target.descr: Main tissue component or structure highlighted by the stain, e.g., nuclei, cytoplasm, collagen.

stain_formulation.descr: Free-text formulation or recipe of the stain, including constituent chemicals and concentrations when available.

stain_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the stain reagent.

stain_catalog_number.descr: Catalog or product number for the stain reagent.

stain_batch_number.descr: Batch, lot, or serial number of the stain reagent.

stain_expiration_date.descr: Expiration date of the stain reagent, if known.

stain_preparation_date.descr: Date the stain working solution or formulation was prepared.

stain_working_concentration.descr: Final working concentration of the stain, if applicable.

stain_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for working concentration, e.g., mg/mL, %, mol/L.

counterstain_name.descr: Name of any counterstain used in the protocol, if applicable.

counterstain_formulation.descr: Free-text formulation of the counterstain, if applicable.

protocol_name.descr: Name or identifier of the staining protocol used.

protocol_reference.descr: Citation, URL, SOP identifier, or other reference for the protocol.

staining_method.descr: Application method, e.g., manual, automated stainer, microwave-assisted.

staining_instrument.descr: Instrument or platform used for staining, if any.

staining_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during staining in degrees Celsius, if controlled or known.

staining_duration_min.descr: Total staining duration in minutes, if applicable.

deparaffinization_used.descr: Whether deparaffinization was performed before staining.

rehydration_used.descr: Whether rehydration was performed before staining.

differentiation_used.descr: Whether a differentiation step was used in the stain protocol.

bluing_used.descr: Whether a bluing step was used in the stain protocol.

mounting_medium.descr: Mounting medium used after staining, e.g., resinous medium, aqueous mountant.

coverslipped.descr: Whether the slide was coverslipped after staining.

protocol_modifications.descr: Description of any deviations, optimizations, or modifications from the standard protocol.

protocol_operator.descr: Person, lab, or facility that performed the staining, if recorded.

quality_control_status.descr: Outcome of staining quality control, e.g., pass, fail, acceptable, rework.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on staining quality, artifacts, unevenness, background, or other issues.

artifact_notes.descr: Observed artifacts or preparation issues affecting interpretation, if any.

morphology_assessment_focus.descr: Primary morphological features assessed, e.g., architecture, inflammation, necrosis, fibrosis.

pathology_use_case.descr: Intended pathology or research use, e.g., diagnosis, grading, biomarker correlation, disease phenotyping.

diagnostic_category.descr: Diagnostic category or classification scheme used, if applicable.

observer_name.descr: Name or identifier of the pathologist, researcher, or annotator who assessed the slide, if applicable.

assessment_date.descr: Date of the morphology or pathology assessment.

annotation_method.descr: Method used for annotation or scoring, e.g., manual review, consensus, digital tool.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the stained specimen or interpretation.
